title: What if the reindeer kept multiplying? #shorts
question: What if the reindeer kept multiplying?
description:
One reindeer walks into a forest camp, and never stops making copies. In eight hours there are 257 of them, and the camp is gone under the herd. 🦌

What would you do with a herd that keeps growing? 👇

Sources:
- The five largest reindeer herds on Earth peak at about 500 000 animals: NOAA Arctic Report Card 2024, Migratory Tundra Caribou in a Warmer Climate https://arctic.noaa.gov/report-card/report-card-2024/migratory-tundra-caribou-in-a-warmer-climate
- Some reindeer herds migrate up to 5 000 kilometres a year, the longest migration of any land mammal: Wikipedia, Reindeer (Rangifer tarandus) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reindeer

3D models: Kenney (CC0)
